description:
Put a Cloudflare Access gate in front of a (staging) hostname so ONLY
    `allowed_email` can load it - the way a neutralized production copy stays private.
    Creates an account-scoped self-hosted Access application + an allow-one-email
    policy. PREFERRED credential path: save the token to a file (chmod 600) and pass
    token_file=<path> - the path is safe in chat, the secret is not. (Also:
    ZX_CF_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE / ZX_CF_TOKEN_FILE env paths, or ZX_CF_ACCESS_TOKEN /
    ZX_CF_TOKEN raw values.) token=… inline works but hits the transcript. The token
    must carry 'Access: Apps Write' and is NEVER echoed. The Access app lands in YOUR
    account - pass account_id=… (or ZX_CF_ACCOUNT_ID); it defaults to the maintainer's
    only if unset. dry_run shows what it would create; confirm executes. Idempotent
    (reuses an existing app for the hostname).
name: access_app_create
